paite: Huchi in Israel chi tengteng Hebron a David kiang ah ahong pai ua, "Ngai in, na guh leh na sa ka hi uh.
heading: Judah Leh Israel Kumpipa In David Apang / (1 Kro 11.1-9; 14.1-7)

paite: Hun paisa in leng Saul ka tung ua kumpipa ahih lai a leng Israelte pikhia leh pilutpa na hi. TOUPA'N na kiang ah, ka mi Israelte na vak dia, Israelte tung ah heutu in na om ding, achi," achi uhi.
Israel upa tengteng Hebron ah kumpipa kiang ah ahoh uh. Kumpipa David in Hebron ah TOUPA ma ah amau toh thu akhung hi. Huchi in Israelte tung a kumpipa ding in David thau anilh uhi.
Vai ahawm pat tung in David kum sawmthum a upa ahi a, kum sawmli sung vai ahawm hi.
Hebron ah Judahte tung ah kum sagih leh kha guk vai ahawm a; Jerusalem ah Israelte leh Judah tengteng tung ah kum sawmthum-le-thum vai ahawm hi.

Kumpipa leh amite huai gam a teng Jebus mite sim ding in Jerusalem ah ahoh uhi. Huai mite'n David ahong lut theih louh gingta in, David kiang ah, "Hiai ah na hong lut het kei ding. Mittaw leh khebaite'n hon na dal ding uh," achi uhi.
Himahleh David in Zion kulhpi alazou a, huai tuh David khopi ahi.

David in huai ni in, "Jebus mi sual peuhmahte tuiluanna ah paitou uhenla, David mudah khebai leh mittawte that uheh," achi hi. Huaiziak in ahi, "Mittaw leh khebaite inn ah ahong lut kei ding uh," achih uh.
Huchi in David kulh ah ateng a, David khua achi uhi. David in Millo a pan akimvel leh asunglam ah kulh abawl hi,
David in TOUPA, Sepaihte' Pathian akiang a a-om ziak in thupi lam amanoh zel hi.
Tura kumpipa Hiram in David kiang ah mi asawl a, sidar singte akhak a, khutsiamte leh suangseksiamte asawl a, David a ding in inn alamsak uhi.
David in TOUPA'N amah Israel mite tung a kumpipa ding in akipsak a, ami Israelte ziak in alalgam atawisang chih athei hi.
David in Hebron apawtsan nung in Jerusalem a pan mei leh zi aneih behlap hi. Huchi in David in tapate leh tanute anei nawn lai hi.
Jerusalem a aneihte min hiaite ahi: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan leh Solomon,
Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg leh Japhia,
Elishama, Eliada leh Eliphalet.
Himahleh Israel mite kumpipa ding in David thau anilh uh chih Philistia mite'n azak un Philistia mi tengteng David zong ding in ahohtou uh. David in ana za a, kulh sung ah apaisuk hi.
heading: Philistiate Tung A Vualzohna / (1 Kro 14.8-17)

paite: Philistia mite Rephaim Phaizang ah akiphalh uhi.

David in, "Philistia mite sual ding in ka hohtou diam? Amaute ka khut ah na hon pe diam?" chi in TOUPA adong hi. TOUPA'N David kiang ah, "Hohtou in. Philistia mite na khut ah ka hon pe ngeingei ding," achi hi.

Huchi in David Baal-perazim ah ahoh a, huai ah David in amaute asual a, "TOUPA'N ka melmate tuichin khah bang mai in ka ma ah ahon hihdalhsakta," achi hi. Huaiziak in huai mun min, "Baal-perazim," asa hi.
Huai ah amilimte uh anusia ua, David leh amite'n ahal uhi.
Philistia mite apaitou nawn ua, Rephaim Phaizang ah akiphalh uhi.
David in TOUPA adotleh Ama'n, "Hohtou ke'n. Anunglam uah khelh inla, singtheimi kung zawn ah sual in.
Hichi ahi ding, singtheimi lek a pai husa na zakleh gamtang in. Philistia sepaihte sual ding in na ma ah TOUPA akuankheta chihna ahi," achi hi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in David in ahih a; Philistia mite Geba a pan Gazer tan in asual hi.
